Trace, implement and test: leetcode39 combination sum backtracking

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

// dfs
class Solution {
    vector<vector<int>> res;

public:
    vector<vector<int>> combinationSum(vector<int>& candidates, int target) {
        vector<int> curGroup;
        dfs(candidates, target, curGroup, 0, 0);
        return res;
    }
    void dfs(vector<int> &candidates, int target, vector<int> &curGroup, int sum, int startPos)
    {
        if (sum > target)
            return;
        if (sum == target)
            res.push_back(curGroup);
        else
        {
            int curSum = sum;
            for (int i = startPos; i < candidates.size(); i++)
            {
                sum = curSum;                // 保证sum不受同层元素的影响
                sum = sum + candidates[i];
                curGroup.push_back(candidates[i]);
                dfs(candidates, target, curGroup, sum, i);
                curGroup.pop_back();
            }
        }
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    vector<int> candidates = {2, 3, 6, 7};
    int target = 7;
    Solution sol;
    auto res = sol.combinationSum(candidates, target);
    
    return 0;
}
